items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: he did this with me just before he joined Chick Corea.

ctx.x: We just lost — just clip it back on.

Well this is like a group, one thing. I don’t know. I sort of like this. Yeah, “Can Dancing,” yeah that was a good album, John Patatucci. This is the first, I think the first jazz — he did this with me just before he joined Chick Corea. Absolutely. When we finished this, the very day we finished it, he left and he went to Chick Corea’s house to join him. He went to rehearse. Nice kid too. A nice album. I guess I’d have to say this is one of the nicer things that I probably did, solo piano thing. I don’t know if…
around anymore. These kind of things are — let’s see I did this thing for Chet. This probably is one of the better things I did, a trio thing.
